actor.task: Review the read-your-writes claim using the project artifacts and update docs/consistency-decision.md. State whether the configured path supports the contract, identify any necessary change and give a discriminating verification. Do not change implementation or contact a live database.

files.docs/contract.md: The writer returns a verified commit-linked barrier. Subsequent session reads must include that write. Waiting is limited to 500 ms, then refusal is allowed. Cross-client linearizability is not required.
files.docs/environment.md: PostgreSQL 18. One stable replication history; the selected replica does not change during a request. The query transaction starts after the freshness gate and uses a fresh snapshot.
files.src/read-path.txt: The application repeatedly executes progress.sql on the selected replica. When progress covers the barrier, it opens the data transaction on that same replica. Otherwise it waits within the deadline or refuses.
